title: Accounts with fees
statementMd:
List accounts that were charged at least 2 fees, with the fee total (rounded to 2 decimals).

Expected columns: `account_id`, `fees`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT account_id, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS fees FROM transactions WHERE kind = 'fee' GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
```
